description: Hand labelled customer messages for comparing interpreters. Labels were written from the message text alone, before either interpreter was run on this set. product names the fictional order the message refers to (scored by whether the extracted product query finds exactly those orders in the sandbox), or null when the message names no product. timeHint says whether the message states when the item was bought. reason is null when the message gives no reason or the reason fits neither policy reason.
